notes.title: New Patch Live Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722259/b1d31100c8dc9089face7c2449784d8f3cf5feb7.jpg[/img]

Our latest update brings a host of thrilling enhancements and content additions:

[b]Toggle Enemy BS Animation[/b]
•	Now, the enemy battle sequence animation is switched off for faster, smoother gameplay experience!

[b]DLC Expansion[/b]
•	If purchased, Nichole's Home Brew is now available in all maps of the free DLC "To Danse with Ravenous Shadows".

[b]Expand your Brain[/b]
•	Customize your character even further with increased perk tree capacity from 30 to 36, offering more freedom in skill development.

[b]Introducing - New Perks that unlock three new ally companions.[/b]
•	Barbarian Battle Buddy
If there is room in your party, a mighty Barbarian joins you in battle! Uses a Battleaxe, Bull Rush, Fart Escape.

•	Amazing Wizard's Apprentice
If there is room in your party, a powerful Wizard joins you in battle! Using a Staff, Gravity Bomb, Bubble Shield, and a Bullshit Power.

•	Tactical Tree Hugger
If there is room in your party, a crafty Ranger joins you in battle! Uses Bow & Daggers, Drones, Snowball Turrets.

[b]Optimizations & Balancing[/b]
•	Enjoy smoother gameplay with several bug fixes, optimizations, and balance improvements for a better, more refined experience!
•	DLC update: Nichole’s Horns are now unlocked correctly when all chapters are completed with two Brews active.
•	Issues that caused loss of progress were fixed.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-07-15
notes.notes:
A new patch has just been released!

We've added a fresh pass of new sounds and feedback for several areas of the game, including boss fights, combat, enemies, and Bullshit Powers. 
[list]
[*] Additional sound design for several boss fights
[*] Updated SFX for player weapons and powers
[*] Updated SFX for Enemy Bullshit events
[*] New SFX for Assassin enemies
[*] New SFX for Clerics
[*] New SFX Mission Complete Screen, Combat Ambience, Objective Banners
[*] Mastering fixes to some English VO lines
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-06-27
notes.notes:
Today's patch includes the following fixes/additions:

[list]
[*] Tightened up melee weapon hit areas and movement
[*] Targeting improvements to open loot containers from any angle
[*] Tweaked dodge cooldown period to increase player feedback
[*] Added aiming friction and light targeting assist to the bow & arrow for controllers
[*] Collision issues were fixed.
[*] Snowball cards in Butter’s Book Law is fixed.
[*] Cosmetic: Skinny Cartman hat was added.
[/list]

notes.title: First update for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! going live today
notes.notes:
The patch addresses various issues across all platforms. Please find the details for PC below:

[list]
[*] Fixed some stability issues.
[*] Fixed a visual glitch of Henrietta in Kupa Keep for clients.
[*] Optimized and fixed some issues for Danse with Ravenous Shadows.
